warning: This manifest defines the planned controlled comparison. It contains no model predictions, labels, or benchmark scores.

shared_controls.model_provider: same configured provider for all arms
shared_controls.model_id: same exact model identifier for all arms
shared_controls.output_token_budget: same cap across arms; record the resolved provider cap
shared_controls.dataset_split: freeze one held-out split before comparison
shared_controls.prompt_revision: record per arm; do not tune against the held-out split
shared_controls.execution_commit: record the commit SHA for each arm

datasets.name: SciFact-Open
datasets.purpose: open-domain evidence retrieval and claim verification

datasets.name: Chronicle temporal-update holdout
datasets.purpose: multi-hop impact precision/recall, false alarms and missed high-impact entities

configurations.name: Standard RAG
configurations.definition: Single-pass retrieval and answer generation without agent-led research planning.

configurations.name: Iterative research agent
configurations.definition: Bounded query planning/research iteration and synthesis; no persisted claim/provenance graph or temporal propagation.

configurations.name: Claim and provenance graph without temporal propagation
configurations.definition: Source-linked claims and typed graph relations; temporal source-event propagation is excluded from the measured arm.

configurations.name: Full lifecycle prototype
configurations.definition: Claim/provenance graph plus source-event impact propagation, targeted reassessment, report version history and audit.

outputs.inputs: One labelled JSONL prediction file per arm, each with identical unique record_id sets.
outputs.result_file: JSON metrics by arm and D-minus-A deltas
